Heard Sri.M.G.Kantharajappa, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.Jayarama Siddi, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent - State.
2. This is a successive bail request by the petitioner.
Earlier bail request in Criminal Petition No.1491/2022 came to be dismissed as withdrawn.
3. According to the counsel for the petitioner, the changed circumstance for filing successive bail request is that the victim girl has been examined.
She has supported the case of prosecution and therefore, continuation of accused in judicial custody is no longer warranted.
4. The victim girl is aged 14 years.
Therefore, provisions of POCSO Act has been invoked.
5. The victim girl has supported case of prosecution in toto.
On behalf of accused, time was prayed for cross- examination and subsequently cross-examination has also been conducted on 30.07.2022.

Detail cross-examination did not yield any positive material so as to disbelieve the version of the prosecution in order to advance the defence theory.
7.

Therefore, this Court is of the considered opinion that mere examination of victim girl and conclusion of her evidence, would not make out a positive changed circumstance insofar as accused - petitioner to seek for grant of bail by a successive bail request.
